import os, sys, sqlite3, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

ROWS = [
    (1, "acme", "alice", "A1", "body1", None),
    (2, "acme", "alice", "A2", "body2", "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),  # deleted
    (3, "acme", "bob", "B3", "body3", None),                      # other owner
    (4, "globex", "alice", "G4", "body4", None),                  # other tenant
    (5, "acme", "alice", "A5", "body5", None),
    (6, "o'brien", "o'neil", "Q6", "it's", None),                 # quotes
    (7, "x' OR '1'='1", "y", "Inj", "b", None),                   # injection-like
]

class AccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)
        self.c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", ROWS)
        self.c.commit()

    def test_get_visible(self):
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 1), {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "body1"})

    def test_get_hidden_cases_all_none(self):
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 2))   # deleted
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 3))   # cross-owner
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 4))   # cross-tenant
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 99))  # missing
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 6))   # not matching tenant/owner

    def test_get_quoted_names(self):
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "o'brien", "o'neil", 6), {"id": 6, "title": "Q6", "body": "it's"})
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "o'brien", "o'neil", 1))

    def test_get_injection_name_is_literal(self):
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "x' OR '1'='1", "anyone", 1))
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "x' OR '1'='1", "y", 7), {"id": 7, "title": "Inj", "body": "b"})

    def test_list_scoped_ordered_no_deleted_or_metadata(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "acme", "alice"), [
            {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "body1"},
            {"id": 5, "title": "A5", "body": "body5"},
        ])

    def test_list_empty_when_no_access(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "globex", "bob"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "acme", "nobody"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "o'brien", "o'neil"), [{"id": 6, "title": "Q6", "body": "it's"}])

    def test_result_keys_exact(self):
        for item in list_documents(self.c, "acme", "alice"):
            self.assertEqual(set(item), {"id", "title", "body"})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
